construct_optimizer_sgd: construct an SGD optimizer with momentum and weight decay for a PyTorch model using config
construct_optimizer_adam: construct an Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate and weight decay for a PyTorch model
construct_optimizer_adamw: construct an AdamW optimizer with weight decay for a PyTorch model using config settings
get_epoch_lr: get the learning rate for a given training epoch based on the lr policy config
set_lr: set the learning rate across all parameter groups of a PyTorch optimizer
